title: Road-trip comfort, road feel, and eyes-on-road usability
summary: Feedback in this topic combines praise for long-trip comfort and confident road feel with a smaller set of complaints about touchscreen interactions taking attention away from the road, while many examples are descriptive statements without clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise comfortable road-trip driving, strong road feedback, and a planted feel that hugs the road.

negative.summary: Negative reviews criticize touchscreen-heavy controls for forcing drivers to take their eyes off the road.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention eyes-on-road safety, driver-attention requirements, road-hugging feel, and road-trip suitability without a clearly resolved sentiment.

limitations: This topic mixes several related but distinct subjects, including road-trip comfort, handling or road feel, and eyes-on-road safety or interface usability.
Many sampled fragments are labeled undetermined, which limits confidence in a single cohesive sentiment narrative.
Some examples are too brief or ambiguous to determine whether comments about road feel or trip suitability are favorable or unfavorable.
